# Introduction

#### Course: Practice: C++ OOP

## Introduction

Welcome to Practice: C++ OOP!

This is a complementary course created to work hand-in-hand with our Learn C++ OOP course. Use this course to practice your understanding of fundamental C++ concepts.

Each chapter in this course includes practice problems that correspond to the concepts covered in Learn C++ OOP.

![Learn C++ OOP Course](data:image/png;base64,)

Whenever you are stuck on any practice problems, simply revisit the corresponding chapter of Learn C++ OOP and try the problem again.

This course helps you solidify your understanding and build confidence in your C++ skills.

Let's get started.

##### How does it work?

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
